notes_for_evaluator: OUT-OF-SAMPLE (second batch, 2026-09-05): never used to tune a rule, prompt, concept or calibration. Interior project of a flat in a new-build (16 pages: baldų/pertvarų/sienų apdailos planai, grindų, lubų, elektros, durų/grindjuosčių lapai, vonios išklotinės, vizualizacijos). NO patalpų eksplikacija table — dimensions are on the pertvarų planas; the sienų apdailos planas legend states painted walls 202 + 18 = 220 m² and stone tiles 60x120. Contractor scope is bathroom prep + tiles + WALL paint only: his paint row is 'Sienų glaistymas/dažymas' (walls), no GKP ceilings and no ceiling paint are billed, no skirting except tile skirting, no floors. A whole-flat walls+ceilings paint figure is therefore NOT comparable to his 239,4 — see the ceiling key. gt_dimensions empty.
